Anant Singh Bail Cancelled : mokama vidhayak anant sinh ko suprim kort se bara jhatka laga hai. dularchand yadav hatyakand men patna haeekort se mili jamanat suprim kort ne radd kar di hai. adalat ne anant sinh ko 1 disanbar tak sarendar karne ka nirdesh diya hai.
Is phaisle ke bad bihar ki siyasat men halchal tej ho gaee hai. aakhir suprim kort ne anant sinh ki jamanat kyon radd ki? dularchand yadav hatyakand men bihar sarkar ne adalat men kya paksh rakha? aur is phaisle ka anant sinh ki rajnitik sthiti par kya asar par sakta hai?
